text_en: A Shiggaion of David, which he sang to the Lord concerning Cush, a Benjaminite.
text_cn: 达味有感于本雅明族人古士的话， 向上主唱的流离之歌。

text_en: O Lord my God, in you I take refuge; save me from all my pursuers, and deliver me,
text_cn: 上主，我的天主！ 我一心投奔你；求你助我逃脱一切追逐我的人，求你救拔我；

text_en: or like a lion they will tear me apart; they will drag me away, with no one to rescue.
text_cn: 免得有人像狮子一般撕裂我时，无人搭救我。

text_en: O Lord my God, if I have done this, if there is wrong in my hands,
text_cn: 上主！如果我真作了这事， 我主！在我手中就真有罪！

text_en: if I have repaid my ally with harm or plundered my foe without cause,
text_cn: 我若真加害过我的友好， 或无故把我的仇敌劫掠；

text_en: then let the enemy pursue and overtake me, trample my life to the ground, and lay my soul in the dust. Selah
text_cn: 就让敌人追逐我，擒获我， 把我的性命践踏在污地， 将我的光荣归诸于泥灰。 （休止）

text_en: Rise up, O Lord , in your anger; lift yourself up against the fury of my enemies; awake, O my God; you have appointed a judgment.
text_cn: 上主，求你震怒奋起，前来克制我仇的暴慢。 我的天主，求你醒来助我，施行你定的断案。

text_en: Let the assembly of the peoples be gathered around you, and over it take your seat on high.
text_cn: 愿万民聚齐环绕着你。 愿你回驾由高处鉴视。

text_en: The Lord judges the peoples; judge me, O Lord , according to my righteousness and according to the integrity that is in me.
text_cn: 上主，万民的审判者！ 上主，请照我的正义， 请按我的无罪， 护卫我的权利。

text_en: O let the evil of the wicked come to an end, but establish the righteous, you who test the minds and hearts, O righteous God.
text_cn: 公义的天主！惟你洞察肺腑和人心， 愿恶人的毒害停止，求你坚固义人！

text_en: God is my shield, who saves the upright in heart.
text_cn: 天主是我的护盾， 给心正的人助阵。

text_en: God is a righteous judge, and a God who has indignation every day.
text_cn: 天主是公义的审判者， 对怙（hù ）恶（è）的人终日怒吓。

text_en: If one does not repent, God will whet his sword; he has bent and strung his bow;
text_cn: 仇人虽然磨刀擦剑， 开弓拉弦准备射箭；

text_en: he has prepared his deadly weapons, making his arrows fiery shafts.
text_cn: 那只是为自己预备死亡的武器， 为自己制造带火的箭矢。

text_en: See how they conceive evil, and are pregnant with mischief, and bring forth lies.
text_cn: 试看，他既孕恶怀毒， 自然就要产生虚无，

text_en: They make a pit, digging it out, and fall into the hole that they have made.
text_cn: 他挖掘坑穴，摆布陷阱， 势必落在自备的窖中。

text_en: Their mischief returns upon their own heads, and on their own heads their violence descends.
text_cn: 他的凶恶必反转到自己头上， 他的横暴必降落在自己顶上。

text_en: I will give to the Lord the thanks due to his righteousness, and sing praise to the name of the Lord , the Most High.
text_cn: 我要称谢上主的公道， 歌颂至高上主的名号。
